🚨 BREAKING NEWS

A gas line has been damaged near the 5500 block of Border Collie Drive in the Wright Ranch Subdivision in Laredo, and residents are being asked to stay away from the area or stay in place due to a lingering gas smell.

Laredo Fire and the gas company are working on the site, and a strong gas smell has been reported in the area.

Fire authorities have asked the community to stay away from the area or stay in place while crews work to address the damaged line. Additional information will be provided as it becomes available.

Sources: Laredo Fire Department advisory, as relayed to Webb Watch 956.

title: BREAKING: Gas line damaged in Wright Ranch area — residents asked to stay away or stay in place
